== Summary ==
Slip “You Will Go To The Dagobah System” cut unchanged from page 9 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 839, 1102, 1124)). Version [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
